Input image 1 is a STYLE AND ARCHITECTURE REFERENCE ONLY. Create a new master with the following layout; do not retain its book or floating astrolabe.

Primary request: epic fantasy game key art, semi-realistic PAINTERLY, premium AAA gacha quality. An immense round library tower at night, circular tiers of curved bookshelves, champagne-gold balcony rails, deep indigo and violet shadows, warm candlelight and cool silver-blue moonlight through an open round star oculus. Exquisite hand-painted environmental art with clearly separated foreground, middle ground and distant architecture, suitable for later cutting into 2.5D parallax layers. Rich and sophisticated rather than cartoonish or a clinical 3D render.

Composition: near-symmetrical wide shot, camera eye level SLIGHTLY HIGHER than the CENTRAL EMPTY LECTERN, looking straight toward it. Camera is not near the ceiling, not extreme low angle. Central lectern centered at x=50%; its EMPTY TOP surface appears at y=60% from top, base near y=83%. The top is a broad gently visible FLAT HORIZONTAL marble slab where a separately animated book can later float. No sloping bookrest and absolutely NOTHING placed on it. Sculptural ivory marble pedestal, subtle grey-gold veins, elegant carved base and fine champagne-gold edging; dignified, physically coherent and clearly readable. Natural soft contact shadow on floor.

Show the circular library at many receding distances: seven or eight rings of dark warm walnut bookcases and carved balcony galleries ascend toward the high starry opening, luminous gold balusters, fine pilasters, tiny celestial motifs in the moldings. Bookshelves filled with jewel-toned crimson, indigo, emerald, brown and violet leather volumes, gold abstract tooling, no lettering. Keep mid-distance balcony sections distinct on left and right, farther rear shelves smaller and cooler, and a few substantial nearest wooden columns/bookshelf edges and warm brass candelabra framing the left and right edges. These foreground framing pieces stay at the outer edges, never covering the central lectern. Do not paint floating books: those are separate animated assets.

Top edge: clearly visible circular open oculus near top center, its lower rim visible and its highest portion may extend beyond the top frame, subtle blue-violet nebula and tiny silver stars beyond it. Fine carved dark wood dome ribs and gold constellation ornaments around opening. Several gentle diagonal silver-blue moonlight shafts, fine distant dust and tasteful atmospheric depth. Warm candlelight scattered in pools throughout all library tiers, refined expensive gold reflections.

Lower image: continuous polished ivory and pale grey marble floor, restrained soft reflections, a wide gold astronomical inlay circle correctly foreshortened in perspective around the lectern, delicate star points and NON-ALPHABETIC geometric sigils. Generous clear floor in front. All architecture is believable and consistent with one camera, no impossible interwoven floors. Dark indigo #14102A and #2A2250, violet #5B4AA0, champagne gold #C99A4A, amber #FFCF8D, moonlight #9CCAFF. Glowing highlights remain controlled, painted contours readable for cutouts, no heavy blur or bloom.

Extend plausible painted architecture and floor to all four canvas edges with about 6% safe overscan: no important objects clipped at the outermost edges, no borders. This is the serene idle scene before summoning, not an effect explosion.
STRICT: NO BOOK OR OBJECT ON THE LECTERN, NO ASTROLABE ANYWHERE, NO floating books, NO characters, NO people, NO statues, NO readable text or letters, NO logo, NO UI, NO watermark. No neon portal, no central light beam, no dark gothic ruin, no skulls or cobwebs, no cartoon, no chibi, no photo.

Primary request: the front cover of an ancient arcane grimoire, perfectly flat orthographic FRONT VIEW, evenly lit. Aged MIDNIGHT-BLACK LEATHER, luxurious yet mysterious and sacred. Exceptionally refined premium semi-realistic painterly AAA fantasy game craftsmanship.

The physical rectangular cover fills the ENTIRE image edge-to-edge: top image edge is top cover edge, bottom image edge is bottom cover edge. No background, padding, tabletop or outer cast shadow. The design feels like a serious ancient magical instrument, elegant and controlled. Keep a strong readable focal seal while preserving exquisite small engraving detail. Borders of small abstract invented angular runic motifs around the edges, made of geometrical strokes, not resembling a readable real alphabet. Gold paths connecting the center to the perimeter should remain distinct and visually continuous for tracing. Black, muted champagne gold, a hint of cool midnight-blue in the leather only. Expensive, dignified, arcane, sacred. No gemstones or neon accents.
STRICT: no readable words, letters, titles, logos, numbers, watermark, people, faces, skulls, dragons, eyes, scene, border outside the cover, 3D perspective, floating book, book stand, page edges or extra objects. No cartoon, chibi or photograph.
